summary: Executed scoped frontend+native regression for touch-player-2 flow, host JSON bridge, launch guard behavior, and Kotlin compile confidence checks. Frontend unit suite passed (39/39). SDK-backed native typecheck found a real Kotlin compile error in WebAppInterface.playMedia. Browser validations used MOCKED OnNowTV bridge + controlled fixtures (CDP touch verified).

integration_issues.issue: WebAppInterface.playMedia passes Activity to NativePlaybackSession.launch(MainActivity,...), causing Kotlin type mismatch compile failure.

integration_issues.flow: Desktop playback details open in one run
integration_issues.issue: Intermittent failure reproduced once: click on [data-testid='playback-details-open'] did not produce dialog before timeout in 1920x800 run; mobile run did open and verify dialog fields.

action_items: Fix compile error in /app/android/vesper-tv/app/src/main/java/tv/vesper/app/WebAppInterface.kt line calling NativePlaybackSession.launch: pass MainActivity safely (cast/guard) or widen launch signature.
Retest desktop playback details open/close focus return path at 1920x800 after native compile fix to confirm no intermittent dialog-open issue.
After APK rebuild, validate on real phone/tablet device because browser bridge validations here are MOCKED and cannot verify physical player decoding/handoff timing.
critical_code_review_comments: NativePlaybackSession.launch strictly requires MainActivity, but WebAppInterface stores Activity; direct call is currently uncompilable under SDK-backed typecheck.
Host.playVideo JSON bridge path now has good requestId/status dispatch behavior and call-time bridge resolution; added regression tests to preserve this.
Touch activation edge-case matrix (drag/cancel/multitouch/longpress/compat-click suppression/touch fallback) is now covered by unit tests and passing.

CDP touch validation succeeded on /title/movie/tt0133093 (stationary touch launch once; swipe did not add calls). SDK-backed Kotlin typecheck (not APK packaging) failed on WebAppInterface.playMedia type mismatch; brace checks for 5 changed Kotlin files passed.
rca of the issue: Compile RCA: NativePlaybackSession.launch(activity: MainActivity, id: String, payload: String) is invoked from WebAppInterface.playMedia where activity is typed as Activity. Kotlin rejects Activity->MainActivity mismatch during typecheck. Repro: ANDROID_HOME=/tmp/vesper-sdk ANDROID_SDK_ROOT=/tmp/vesper-sdk ./gradlew -I /app/tests/vesper_classpath.init.gradle :app:printVerificationClasspath then python /app/tests/typecheck_vesper_native.py; error points to WebAppInterface.kt playMedia call. Mitigation: guard cast (activity as? MainActivity) and fail/emit message when null, or relax NativePlaybackSession.launch parameter type if intended.
